asked.item: Why Pinterest shows 'Sorry! This site doesn't allow you to save Pins'
How to get around it for their own blog link

verdict.reason: The Troubleshooting page covers this exact Pinterest error, its common causes, and the query parameter workaround.

steps.text: This error comes from Pinterest, not Blotato.
Pinterest blocked the destination link in your pin, either because the website opted out of being pinned or because Pinterest's blocklist flagged your URL, which is often a false positive.
To work around it, add a query parameter to the end of your link, for example ?ref=pin or ?v=111, so Pinterest reads it as a new URL.
Use the modified link in your pin and publish again.
